description: This file defines a React functional component called DeviceCreate, which provides a form interface for creating a new device. It manages form submission, handles navigation, and interacts with an API to create the device.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by calling the API to create a device and navigating back to the devices list upon success.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancel action by navigating back to the devices list without submitting.
